rename.how: ran `ssh exe.dev "rename fleet-golden-next fleet-golden"` live on the golden swap (RUNBOOK §Golden VM build step 4); the swapped image served every run since.

new.how: built both `fleet-golden` and `fleet-orchestrator` with `ssh exe.dev "new --name=… --cpu=… --memory=… --setup-script=… --json"` (RUNBOOK §Golden VM build, §Orchestrator VM); both VMs are live.

ssh-key.how: registered the orchestrator's key tag-scoped with `ssh exe.dev "ssh-key add --tag=fleet '<pubkey>'"` (RUNBOOK §Orchestrator VM step 2); the orchestrator has provisioned fleet VMs with that key since.

tag.how: ran `ssh exe.dev "tag fleet-golden fleet"` (RUNBOOK §Orchestrator VM step 2); clones of fleet-golden inherit the tag, which is what keeps the tag-scoped key working.

ls.how: ran `ssh exe.dev "ls --json"` for the §Capacity allocation-vs-meter comparison (31 vCPU summed from its rows) and for the §Teardown guarantee orphan sweep.

billing.how: ran `ssh exe.dev "billing usage --json"` and `ssh exe.dev "billing plan --json"` (RUNBOOK §Capacity) to confirm the account is nowhere near its meter before raising wave WIDTH.

stat.how: ran `ssh exe.dev "stat <vmName> --json --range=24h"` for the per-VM peak-vs-mean question in §Capacity; `drive.mjs:212` issues the same call into every run's evidence bundle.
